Section(s): Appendix A. List of model equations (Kontoravdi et al., 2005)

Text and equations in reading order:
    The heavy- and light-chain mRNA balances are
(17) \frac{d m_{H}}{d t}=N_{H}S_{H}-K m_{H}    [code: ODE, computes m_{H}, code proposes balance]
(18) \frac{d m_{L}}{d t}=N_{L}S_{L}-K m_{L}    [code: ODE, computes m_{L}, code proposes balance]
    The intraER heavy- and light-chain and assembly intermediates balances are
(19) \frac{d[H]}{d t}=T_{H}m_{H}-R_{H}    [code: ODE, computes [H], code proposes balance]
(20) \frac{d[L]}{d t}=T_{L}m_{L}-R_{L}    [code: ODE, computes [L], code proposes balance]
    where
(21) R_{H}=\frac{2}{3}K_{A}[H]^{2}    [code: algebraic, computes R_{H}, code proposes constitutive]
(22) R_{L}=2K_{A}[H_{2}][L]+K_{A}[H_{2}L][L]    [code: algebraic, computes R_{L}, code proposes constitutive]
(23) \frac{d[H_{2}]}{d t}=\frac{1}{3}K_{A}[H]^{2}-2K_{A}[H_{2}][L]    [code: ODE, computes [H_2], code proposes balance]
    and
(24) \frac{d[H_{2}L]}{d t}=2K_{A}[H_{2}][L]-K_{A}[H_{2}L][L]    [code: ODE, computes [H_2L], code proposes balance]
    The intraER MAb balance is

Symbols:
  m_{H}: Heavy-chain mRNA amount per cell. [mRNA/cell] (computed)
  N_{H}: Heavy-chain gene copy number per cell. [gene/cell] (parameter)
  S_{H}: Heavy-chain gene-specific transcription rate. [mRNA/gene-h] (parameter)
  K: Heavy- and light-chain mRNA decay rate. [h^-1] (parameter)
  m_{L}: Light-chain mRNA amount. [mRNA/cell] (computed)
  N_{L}: Light-chain gene copy number. [gene/cell] (parameter)
  S_{L}: Light-chain gene-specific transcription rate. [mRNA/gene-h] (parameter)
  [H]: Intra-ER heavy-chain concentration. [molecule/cell] (computed)
  T_{H}: Heavy-chain-specific translation rate. [chain/mRNA-h] (parameter)
  R_{H}: Rate of heavy-chain consumption in assembly. [chain/cell/h] (computed)
  [L]: Intra-ER light-chain concentration. [molecule/cell] (computed)
  T_{L}: Light-chain-specific translation rate. [chain/mRNA-h] (parameter)
  R_{L}: Rate of light-chain consumption in assembly. [chain/cell/h] (computed)
  K_{A}: Assembly rate constant. [cell/molecule/h] (parameter)
  [H_2]: Intra-ER heavy-chain dimer concentration. (computed)
  [H_2L]: Intra-ER heavy-chain dimer–light-chain assembly intermediate concentration. (computed)
